disposition_reason: Adds Annex I entry 3.6.12 'Cocoa and chocolate products' with nickel MLs of 2,5 mg/kg (milk chocolate <30% total dry cocoa solids), 7,0 mg/kg (milk chocolate >=30% and chocolate) and 15 mg/kg (cocoa powder and fat-reduced cocoa powder for the final consumer or drinking-chocolate ingredient), applicable from 1 July 2025.
disposition_locator: Annex (new entry 3.6), rows 3.6.12.1-3.6.12.3, PDF p. 6; Article 1(1)(b) point (o); Article 2

study.material_scope: cocoa and chocolate products (footnote 14 of 2023/915: Directive 2000/36/EC definitions)
study.basis: mg/kg, product as placed on the market

regulatory.instrument: Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1987 of 30 July 2024 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/915 as regards maximum levels of nickel in certain foodstuffs (OJ L, 2024/1987, 31.7.2024)
regulatory.product: Milk chocolate with < 30 % total dry cocoa solids
regulatory.status: applies from 1 July 2025; food lawfully placed on market before 1 July 2025 may remain until date of minimum durability
regulatory.basis: product as placed on the market

regulatory.instrument: Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1987 of 30 July 2024 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/915 as regards maximum levels of nickel in certain foodstuffs (OJ L, 2024/1987, 31.7.2024)
regulatory.product: Milk chocolate with ≥ 30 % total dry cocoa solids and chocolate
regulatory.basis: product as placed on the market

regulatory.instrument: Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1987 of 30 July 2024 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/915 as regards maximum levels of nickel in certain foodstuffs (OJ L, 2024/1987, 31.7.2024)
regulatory.product: Cocoa powder and fat reduced cocoa powder placed on the market for the final consumer or as an ingredient in sweetened cocoa powder or powdered chocolate placed on the market for the final consumer (drinking chocolate)
regulatory.basis: product as placed on the market

unresolved: Row 3.6.16.2 (1,0 mg/kg Ni) covers fruit juices/nectars from 'cocoa fruits' (cocoa pulp juice), which is outside the cocoa page scope; not recorded as a cocoa limit.
No nickel ML is set for cocoa beans, nibs or cocoa butter.
